reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Sunscreen 40ml
reviews.text: It's really good .it's not feels on the skin
reviews.zh: 真係好好用。搽上面完全無存在感。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Sunscreen 40ml
reviews.text: This is an amazing SPF cream! I usually can't stand the typical smell of SPF products, but this one is different. It has an incredibly lightweight, silky texture, spreads in a very thin layer, and doesn't have that usual sunscreen scent. I absolutely love it.
reviews.zh: 勁正嘅防曬霜！平時我真係頂唔順防曬嘅典型味道，但呢支完全唔同。質地超輕超滑，薄薄一層就推開，亦都冇一般防曬嗰陣味。真心大愛。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Sunscreen 40ml
reviews.text: Nice moisturizing sunscreen that goes on well under makeup. The only complaint is that the volume is smaller than other sunscreen!
reviews.zh: 保濕防曬唔錯，搽完再上妝都好服貼。唯一投訴就係容量比一般防曬細！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Sunscreen 40ml
reviews.text: Amazing product! I really love it 😍 makes the skin feel and look amazing
reviews.zh: 產品超正！真心大愛 😍 用完皮膚狀態又好又靚。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Sunscreen 40ml
reviews.text: I took it to test on my sensitive skin because lately all the SPFs with chemical filters are burning.
reviews.zh: 我拎去我嘅敏感肌試，因為近排所有化學防曬成分嘅防曬都會刺刺地。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Sunscreen 40ml
reviews.text: Great sunscreen. Have noticed calming to my natural rednesss anytime I use it. Wish it came in a larger size!
reviews.zh: 防曬好正。每次用都見到我本身泛紅嘅地方有舒緩到。如果有大容量就好喇！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Sunscreen 40ml
reviews.text:
Didn’t try it yet. 
Loved the other round lab sunscreens, hyped up.
reviews.zh:
仲未試。
不過其他 round lab 防曬我都用過好鍾意，所以對呢支都好有期望。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Sunscreen 40ml
reviews.text: It was all right nothing special and although I LOVE the calming cica line from round lab this one didn’t stand out to me )))
reviews.zh: 一般啦，冇咩特別，雖然我好鍾意 round lab 嘅 cica 舒緩系列，但呢支就冇咩突出嘅地方 )))
